CFML Language Reference: Functions

StructClear

Deletes every key and value from a structure. The structure itself stays, empty.

Category

Structure functions

Syntax

StructClear(structure)

Parameters

structure
The structure to empty.

Returns

TRUE (prints as YES).

Usage

Because structures are passed by reference, every variable that points to the same structure sees it emptied. StructClear also works on scopes that behave like structures; StructClear(Session) inside an exclusive CFLOCK is the classic "log out" button.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Basket = StructNew()>
<CFSET Basket.Apples = 3>
<CFSET Basket.Pears = 2>
<CFSET SameBasket = Basket>
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>Before: #StructCount(Basket)# keys</P>
<CFSET Temp = StructClear(Basket)>
<P>After StructClear: #StructCount(Basket)# keys.
StructIsEmpty(SameBasket) = #StructIsEmpty(SameBasket)#
(it is the same structure).</P>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

StructDelete, StructIsEmpty, StructNew, ArrayClear
